actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 384 - 0 (Roll no. 208). (text: CR H3929)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 384 - 0 (Roll no. 208). (text: CR H3929)
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H3974-3975)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 8466.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H3928-3930)
Mr. Gill (TX) moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended.
Ordered to be Reported (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 40 - 0.
Committee Consideration and Mark-up Session Held
Referred to the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform.

committees.name: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee

dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agencies and their management personnel, as well as congressional committees receiving reports.
dimensions.evidence: Each plan must include procedures to (1) evaluate the risk of financial loss to the federal government

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative changes to internal controls and planning procedures for emergency spending without directly altering individual entitlements or private sector requirements.
dimensions.evidence: develop and implement plans for preventing fraud and improper payments relating to federal emergency spending

dimensions.assessment: Explicitly prohibits any additional funds from being authorized to carry out the Act.
dimensions.evidence: No additional funds are authorized to be appropriated for the purpose of carrying out this Act.

dimensions.assessment: Amends federal statute to establish new planning, reporting, and review requirements for emergency supplemental appropriations across covered agencies.
dimensions.evidence: Requirement for financial and administrative controls for emergency spending

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent statutory requirements for agencies to maintain, review, and revise plans every three years.
dimensions.evidence: review and if necessary update, guidance to covered agencies for the development of plans

missing_information: Exact count of covered agencies affected
importance_detail.rationale: The bill directs federal agencies to develop and implement internal control plans for preventing fraud and improper payments in emergency spending, and requires OMB to issue guidance and report annually to Congress.
